messages:
maria: Observed a weird billing spike in the canary cluster yesterday ~04:13 UTC. Lots of tiny charges (~5-10 tokens) from streaming sessions that then retried and triggered toolcalls. attaching a few log lines.
raj: Saw this too. Session id s-9a7f... stream got truncated on fallback, client reconnected and retried the toolcall — counts show provisional != confirmed.
alex: Log snippet I pulled: 
```
[04:13:22] session=s-9a7f prefix_len=12 emitted=8 stream_eof=true toolcall_id=tc-42 routed=dc-west
[04:13:22] reconnect start -> new_session=s-9a7f-1 toolcall_id=tc-42
```
maria: Notice toolcall_id is the same but session changed. Ledger got credited twice (provisional for old session, confirmed for new). double-charge.
june: Our dedupe key right now is (session_id, toolcall_id). with a new session we lose dedupe.
raj: UX problem on console as well — provisional appears under old session and confirmed under new. support ticket confusion.
alex: Two options: a) canonical_toolcall_id that survives handoffs (requires plumbing), b) persist original_session_id in routing metadata so ledger dedupe can use orig_session. which is faster?
june: b is faster — adding orig_session to route metadata is small. but long-term canonical_toolcall is cleaner.
maria: Ops/console ask: can we expose provisional vs confirmed breakdown per-route and a "handoff_count" tag? they'd like an alert when provisional > 20% of confirmed for a route.
raj: Also on truncation: clients replay the last N tokens after reconnect; billing should use server-confirmed token index (the ack stream) not client replay to avoid double-charging. we do have token indexes in stream acks. can we rely on them?
june: yes, we can persist last_confirmed_index on the session and use that to clamp prefix charges. i'll add that to session metadata.
alex: Short-term mitigation: change ledger dedupe to look for `toolcall.client_id` (client-supplied stable id) when present. that collapses most dupes without big infra work. i'll send a PR.
raj: mid-term: canonical_toolcall_id becomes source of truth; we need it to survive routing handoffs and retries. add to roadmap.
maria: Console change: add a small status badge on route pages "provisional/confirmed" with numbers and a link to traces that show handoff events. also add a tooltip explaining provisional charging semantics.
ajune: Telemetry: add trace attribute `route.handoff_origin` and sample 1% extra traces where handoff_origin != null for 24h after deploy. better signal to debug these.
alex: Action items: 
- alex: open PR to dedupe on `toolcall.client_id` and add infra-review tag (small, targets ledger code path).
- june: add `route.handoff_origin` trace attribute + console badge + alert rule change (provisional ratio).
- raj: persist `last_confirmed_index` on session and use for prefix crediting.
- maria: draft customer note for affected canary tenants.
will try to land quick fixes in next patch window.
raj: One more subtlety: if the toolcall is side-effecting we can't just dedupe based on client id alone unless idempotency is guaranteed. we should gate on toolcall idempotency metadata.
june: good point — ledger change will only dedupe when `toolcall.idempotent=true` or when server-side canonical id exists.
alex: I'll add the idempotency check. PR will include tests for replayed stream + toolcall.
maria: Ops — do we need an incident? small P2. notify affected customers but no wide outage.
billing-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042, leads: @alex @june, priority=P2 :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks all. we'll sync at standup for status.
